meta.title: Dev Toolbox
meta.description: Right-sidebar development toolbox: file tree (copy path, drag-to-move, auto-reveal), multi-tab code editor (⌘S save with conflict guard, word wrap, ⌘G go-to-line, ⌘F find with regex/word/case toggles), full-text search (regex, grouping, highlight, context, replace), LSP jumps (Go/TS/Python), image & Markdown/SVG previews, git stage/commit/amend/push/stash/file-history/hunk-revert with side-by-side word-level diffs, skills manager, API tester (curl import/export, query params, timeout, history/favorites, environment variables, multipart), grouped sidebar launcher.
